edges.reason: Constructor assigns the initial reflection supply to the caller address.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the transfer origin and uniswap-only check.
block.timestamp determines the per-wallet cooldown window and is miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
manualswap is gated only by comparing msg.sender to the stored dev address.
manualsend is gated only by comparing msg.sender to the stored dev address.
maxtx is gated only by comparing msg.sender to the stored dev address.
_DevAddress is the recipient of half the distributed ETH.
_marketing is the recipient of half the distributed ETH.
_DevAddress is the authorization subject for manualswap.
_DevAddress is the authorization subject for manualsend.
_DevAddress is the authorization subject for maxtx.
_owner is read in _transfer to exempt owner transfers.
_owner is the privileged caller required by openTrading.
_owner is the privileged caller required by setBots.
_owner is the privileged caller required by setCooldownEnabled.
_owner is required to renounce ownership.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transferred amount.
bots mapping blocks transfers from or to flagged addresses.
cooldown mapping compares against block.timestamp to throttle buys.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether the fee is taken.
cooldownEnabled branches the cooldown and uniswap-only checks.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send block.
uniswapV2Pair is compared with from/to and msg.sender inside _transfer.
uniswapV2Router is used for the token-to-ETH swap call.
uniswapV2Pair is assigned from the factory and later approved.
_rOwned reflection balance is divided by the current rate.
_rTotal seeds the current reflection supply calculation.
_tTotal seeds the current token supply calculation.
_taxFee is consumed by the value computation.
_redisfee is consumed by the value computation.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading resets _maxTxAmount to a fixed cap.
setBots writes into the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldown flag.
maxtx recomputes _maxTxAmount with mul/div arithmetic.
Constructor assigns the developer address.
Constructor assigns the marketing address.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount into _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee subtracts the fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee indirectly depends on the fee configuration restored/removed elsewhere.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to the internal _approve.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer with the takeFee flag.
_transfer triggers an external router swap before completing its own state updates.
_transfer sends ETH out to external addresses within the same transaction.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to move balances.
_tokenTransfer removes fees when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer restores fees after a fee-less transfer.
_transferStandard requests computed values from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard updates reflection balances with add/sub arithmetic.
_getValues derives token values through _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values through _getRValues.
_getValues obtains the current rate via _getRate.
_getRate divides supplies returned by _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection uses the rate from _getRate.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs an unchecked external router swap call.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the whole contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the whole ETH balance.
maxtx performs mul/div arithmetic on the user-supplied percentage.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call with the full ETH balance.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _DevAddress which may execute arbitrary code.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _marketing which may execute arbitrary code.
The router swap can invoke token callbacks that re-enter the transfer logic.
The pair contract can call back into the token transfer entry points during a swap.
A malicious dev address receiving ETH could re-enter the transfer logic.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the _transfer logic and is merged into that function node.
The to parameter only exists to feed the _transfer logic and is merged into that function node.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the _transfer logic and is merged into that function node.
contractTokenBalance is the argument handed to swapTokensForEth and is merged into it.
contractETHBalance is the amount handed to sendETHToFee and is merged into it.
takeFee is the decision flag consumed by _tokenTransfer and is merged into it.
maxTxpc is the input driving the maxtx recomputation and is merged into that function node.
rAmount is a computed intermediate inside _transferStandard and is merged into it.
tAmount is the input of _transferStandard and is merged into it.
